Since September 2024, I am a PhD student of Johan Martens at the University of Edinburgh, funded by the EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Algebra, Geometry, and Quantum Fields. I did my masters under the supervision of Florent Schaffhauser.

My masters thesis was on canonical reductions of principal bundles, which is now a preprint with Florent Schaffhauser. It generalizes Harder-Narasimhan filtrations to symplectic and orthogonal bundles. My bachelors thesis was on the Mitchell embedding theorem.

My email is E [dot] Roth2 [at] ed.ac.uk, but I also use E [dot] Roth [at] sms.ed.ac.uk.

Preprints and papers

Harder-Narasimhan filtrations of decorated vector bundles (2025), on arxiv, with Florent Schaffhauser.

Jordan-Hölder theory for complementary polyhedra and moduli of parahoric Higgs torsors (2026), on arxiv.
